name: SJ Riding Camp – Day Camp
description_short: Horseback riding day camp in Ellington for ages 8 to 13 who are ready for the residential camp's activities but not for staying overnight. Day campers join the overnight campers' daytime schedule, Monday to Friday 8:30am to 6pm, with two rides a day.
refund_policy_summary: The balance, less the deposit, is refunded only if you cancel by May 1, 2027. No refunds for leaving camp early for any reason. Session changes depend on space.

warnings: This page shows the 2026 season, which is over (today is 2026-10-13). June 22 and July 27, 2026 both fall on a Monday, which matches the Monday–Friday schedule. No 2027 dates or prices are posted yet.

The waitlist note was for the 2026 sessions. It does not tell you anything about 2027 availability.
The camp is for girls only, according to the site title 'Horseback Riding Camp for Girls'.
